evidence: app/src/api.ts:35,48 — api<T = any> default leaves the whole API boundary untyped; app/src/views/pokemon.tsx:70-81 and app/src/data.ts:49-81 pass raw `any` records around, so upstream API changes won't be caught by the typecheck
app/src/api.ts:1-50 — all HTTP access and caching centralized in one small module; app/src/data.ts:1-88 keeps shape-normalization in one place — good blast-radius containment
app/src/index.tsx:13 — serveStatic({ root: './dist' }) resolves against process.cwd(), so start breaks if run from another directory; import.meta.url-relative would be churn-proof
app/src/index.tsx:29-36,45 — homeUrl canonicalization lives in one function and sort keys are validated via a Set at the boundary, so URL contract changes touch one file
app/src/api.ts:4-13 — cache Map is unbounded with no eviction; fine for ~1k species but will quietly grow with any API surface expansion
churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is well contained (api.ts/data.ts) and URL/query construction is centralized, so a Hono or htmx upgrade would touch few files. But the `any`-typed API boundary means the most likely source of churn — the upstream data shape — is invisible to the TypeScript check, and the static-file root depends on the launch cwd.

findings.issue: The API boundary is untyped (api<T = any>), and views cast raw records as any (pokemon.tsx:70-81, details.tsx:57, data.ts:49-81), so the TS 7 typecheck cannot catch upstream API shape changes — the main thing that will move
findings.suggestion: Define interfaces for the PokeAPI resources (Species, Pokemon, Move, Ability, Type) in src/data.ts and have api<T> callers pass them; the rest of the code then fails to compile instead of failing at runtime

findings.issue: serveStatic root './dist' is resolved against the process working directory, so npm start silently 404s static assets if launched from another cwd
findings.suggestion: Resolve the static root relative to import.meta.url (e.g. via new URL('./static', import.meta.url)) so the server is cwd-independent

findings.issue: apiUrl extracts the resource path by indexOf('/api/v2/') string slicing instead of URL parsing
findings.suggestion: Use new URL(url).pathname (and pick out the /api/v2/ prefix) so absolute URLs with ports, query strings or trailing subtleties are handled by the platform parser

findings.issue: fetch calls have no AbortController/timeout, so a slow or hung API server stalls page renders indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(...) (Node 24 supports it) to the fetch in load() so failures are bounded and cache entries can't hang

findings.issue: In-memory cache Map is unbounded with no size cap or stale-entry eviction
findings.suggestion: Fine for the current ~1,025-species dataset, but add a simple LRU cap or note the assumption in the module comment if the API surface grows

findings.issue: c.header('Vary', ...) overwrites rather than appends, so any future middleware that also sets Vary would be clobbered
findings.suggestion: Use c.header('Vary', ..., { append: true }) or compose the vary list in one place

summary: This app is current-generation across the board: Hono 4.13.14 with node-server v2 and the documented jsxRenderer pattern, htmx 2.0.11 (the maintained npm-latest line, with htmx 4.0 as a future upgrade), and the TS 7 native compiler paired with esbuild exactly as recommended post-7.0. Dependencies are minimal, exactly pinned, and all needed. The main way it will age badly is the untyped `any` API boundary, which hides upstream data churn from the typecheck that everything else is set up to catch.
